maya: Quick probe results for sparrowhawk-v1 embedding quant paths on wiki50k (5k query holdout). Summary + a few stratified numbers.

jon: paste the table please.

maya: ```
model              r@1    r@5    r@10   silhouette
sparrowhawk-fp16   0.718  0.859  0.897  0.421
sparrowhawk-6pc    0.715  0.854  0.893  0.415
sparrowhawk-4mix   0.691  0.830  0.872  0.372
```

maya: Notes: 6-bit per-channel (6pc) is within noise vs fp16. 4-bit mixed-fallback shows ~2.7% absolute drop r@1 and a notable silhouette drop.

liam: which index and search params?
maya: IVF4096 + HNSW overlay (M=32, efC=200). baseline nprobe=32. ran a follow-up nprobe=64 for 4-bit.

jon: any quick strat by query length?
maya: short (<10 tokens) r@1: fp16=0.695, 6pc=0.690, 4mix=0.656. long (>40 tokens) r@1: fp16=0.748, 6pc=0.745, 4mix=0.739. short queries affected most.

eva: visuals?
maya: UMAP shows several small topical clusters merging under 4-bit; attached in artifacts (internal): https://internal/redwood-artifacts/sparrowhawk/umap-6770001111.png

liam: any norm stats?
maya: mean L2: fp16=12.6, 6pc=12.3, 4mix=9.9. per-vector scalar-rescale using fp16 stats recovers ~0.8% r@1 for 4mix but not full gap. normalizing before index helps a bit.

jon: did you test batch=1 encode vs batch=2048?
maya: batch=1 run kept the gap for 4mix (so not pure accumulation artifact). Also tried disabling kv-cache; no major change.

liam: could be layer-wise sensitivity early in encoder. plan: run layer-sensitivity ablation and per-layer quant fallback mapping.
maya: queued tests for per-layer fallback and a rerank-smoke to see UX impact.
